column2: 1. How much impact does this bottleneck have on the process? (1–3)
column3: 2. What is the likelihood of overcoming this bottleneck? (1–3)
column4: 3. Is this important to a wide range of stakeholders? (1–3)

column1: Example: Unavailability of timely consumption data results in inaccurate forecasts and frequent stockouts.
Example: Aggregating data from paper forms is burdensome and rarely done correctly.
Example: Inability to track and trace health products using serial numbers.
